test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Judges was NOT appointed by the President to the Supreme Court in 2023 after the Centre cleared the proposal by the Collegium that was shared in December last year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudhir Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2023, the Supreme Court Collegium recommended several names for elevation to the Supreme Court, and the President cleared these appointments.
 
• However, **Sudhir Singh** was not one of the judges appointed to the Supreme Court from that list.
 
• Sudhir Singh is a respected **advocate who has been part of several high-profile cases in Indian court**s.
 
• He has been involved in shaping public law discourse and has represented clients in cases of national importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Supreme Court has a sanctioned strength of 34 Judge**s.
 
• With both the Executive and Judiciary, in their own ways, highlighting the importance of filling the judicial vacancies, finally there is some good news in this regard. In exercise of the **powers conferred under Art. 124 (2) of the Constitution,** the President of India gave her seal of approval to the appointment of 5 Judges to the Supreme Court, thus paving way for elevation of 3 High Court Chief Justices and 2 High Court Judges.
 
• The Ministry of Law and Justice notified the appointment of the following Chief Justices and Judges who were recommended for elevation by the Supreme Court Collegium in December 2022
 
• Shri Justice Pankaj Mithal, - Chief Justice- Rajasthan High Court Shri
 
• **Justice Sanjay Karol,- Chief Justice-Patna High Court **
 
• **Shri Justice P.V. Sanjay Kumar- Chief Justice- -Manipur High Court **
 
• **Shri Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah, Judge, Patna High Court, **
 
• **Shri Justice Manoj Misra, Judge, Allahabad High Court**
